products.product_description: Uncle Eddies Vegan Oatmeal Chocolate Cookies, 12 oz. One shipping carton/case consists of 12bags. Product labeling reads in part:"uncle Eddies vegan oatmeal chocolate-chip cookies***net wt. 12 oz (340g)***MFG BY:INTERNATIONAL DESSERTS GLENDALE, CA 91203***(818) 549-0056***www.vegancookies.com***".
